title: EdgeVC-NDN: simulation code, configurations and results for edge-verified credentials in Named Data Networking
description: OMNeT++ 6.0.3 / INET 4.5 / Simu5G simulation code, scenario configurations, run summaries, per-request logs and analysis scripts for the manuscripts 'EdgeVC: Verifying Credentials Where the Cache Is, for Revocable Access Control in Named Data Networking' and 'Edge-Verified Credentials for FHIR Access over 5G New Radio: Break-Glass Auditing and an Adversarial Evaluation'.
